text:
You're losing your best years one night at a time.

It's midnight. You chose quick pleasure again. Call it the midnight drain. You told yourself it's fine.

It's not fine.

Your body makes energy for one reason. To build. Every time you drain it on nothing, you rob tomorrow's version of you.

A study of 25,000 men found most didn't hit their best work until their 40s. They spent their 20s running the midnight drain instead of building with that fuel.

Stop burning it. Build with it instead.
caption:
Success habits and discipline mean nothing if you keep leaking your best energy on nothing. Most men never figure this out until it's too late.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
